name: Perplex
text:
You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly. Choose a target within 30 feet that can hear you, and attempt a Diplomacy check check against its Will DC. The creature is then immune to Perplex for 24 hours.

---
Critical Success The target is Stupefied 3 and Confused for 1 round.

Success The target is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.
